QUOTE: Without the opt-out, `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ctx->private_state`, so the real name `state` no longer exists. Plain `ctx->state` then fails to compile. ... The rename exists only at compile time, and the fields still exist in the binary.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the compile-time rename breaks the member name (`private_state`) and the fields still exist. That matches the item's mechanism: name-breaking rather than layout-hiding.
